title: Cover essential personal expenses (housing, food, utilities)
summary: Same logic as the W-2 path — housing, food, utilities, transportation, healthcare, minimum debt payments.
detailsHtml:
The volatility wrinkle

1099 income is lumpy. Pay yourself a stable "salary" from the business account to your personal account — typically based on your trailing 6-month average income, conservatively estimated. This buffers personal cash flow from monthly income variability and forces the business account to absorb the volatility instead.
